source: Unmodified local run of corepack pnpm hosted:installed <C> <scratch> in the Claude Code cloud container (Node 24.22.2, pnpm 11.5.2). The container ships Chromium headless shell build 1243 instead of the pinned 1234, so PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH pointed at the installed 1243 shell; real browser acceptance ran and passed on it. packed-payload-inventory.json is a copy of the checked verification/hosted-content/current-payload.json written at C.
browser: passed (Chromium headless shell 1243, not the pinned 1234)
